senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Wished, desired.
2 Cherished, beloved.
3 Worshipped, reverenced, respected.
m. (-ष्टः)
1 A lover, a husband.
2 The Castor-oil tree.
n. (-ष्टं)
1 An act of sacrifice, an oblation, &c.
2 An essential ceremony, as ablution, investiture, &c.
ind. (-ष्टम)
Voluntarily.
E.
इष to desire, or इष substituted for यज to sacrifice, and क्त aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
(In arithmetic,) Rule of supposition, operation with an assumed number.
E.
इष्ट wished, and कर्म्मन् act.

f. (-का)
A brick; also इष्टिका.
E.
इष to wish, तकक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-सः)
Laying the foundation of a house.
E.
इष्टका and न्यास order.

n. (-थं)
The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum).
E.
इष्ट wished, and कापथ a bad road, growing in or preferring unfrequented places: this word is sometimes divided, कापथ being one name, and इष्ट added to अवदाह, another name: see अवदाहेष्ट and अवदाह.

f. (-शिः)
A pile of bricks.
E.
इष्टका and राशि a heap.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Fragrant, any fragrant substance.
n. (-न्धं)
Sand.
E.
इष्ट and गन्ध a smell; of a desirable odor.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Beloved, best beloved, dearest, most desired.
E.
इष्ट and तमप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dearer, more dear, more desired.
E.
इष्ट and तरप् aff.

n. (त्वं)
1 Desirableness.
2 Reverence, &c. also इष्टता.
E.
तल् or त्व added to इष्ट.

m. (-वः)
A tutelary deity, one particularly worshipped.
E.
इष्ट and देव a deity.

f. (-ता)
A person's chosen or tutelary divinity.
E.
इष्ट and देवता divinity.

n. (-र्त्तं)
Any religious duty, a oblation, sacrifice, penance, holy study, digging a well, planting a tree, &c.
E.
इष्ट a sacrifice, and पूर्त्त liberal act, religiously considered; आङ् prefixed to the latter.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Zealously active, diligent for a desired object.
E.
इष्ट wished, अर्थ intention, and उद्युक्त diligent.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Wish, desire.
2 A sacrifice, any sacrificial rite.
3 A compendious verse easily committed to memory.
E.
इष to wish, or इष substituted for यज, to sacrifice; affix क्तिन्.

f. (-का)
A brick.
E.
more usually इष्टका.

mfn. (-ष्टी-ष्टिनी-ष्टि)
Who wishes or desires, desirous, wishing.
E.
इष्ट and इनि aff.

m. (-चः)
A demon.
E.
इष्टि a sacrifice or oblation, and पच who digests: stealing oblations to the deities, and eating them.

m. (-मुट्)
A demon.
E.
इष्टि an oblation, and मुष् who steals; from मुष root, and क्विप् aff.

f. (-ष्टुः)
Desire, wish.
E.
इष to wish, तु aff.

ind.
1 Having sacrificed or worshipped.
2 Having wished.
E.
इष with क्त्वा aff.
